description.value: Koi Sushi is a freshly made sushi counter located on the first floor of the University Centre Building at UBC Okanagan, operated by the Students' Union Okanagan. It sits within the campus food services hub alongside other student-union-run outlets including a pub and an Indian cuisine counter. As a campus food outlet, it is primarily oriented toward the university community, though the campus itself is accessible from Kelowna's road network.
